title: High earners via CTE
prompt: Using a CTE named high_earners that selects employees with salary > 60000, return the name and salary from that CTE.
setup_sql: CREATE TABLE emp10 (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, salary INTEGER); INSERT INTO emp10 VALUES (1,'A',50000),(2,'B',90000),(3,'C',75000),(4,'D',40000);
reference_sql: WITH high_earners AS (SELECT name, salary FROM emp10 WHERE salary > 60000) SELECT name, salary FROM high_earners;
